tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// mthong snang phran bu sgyu ma'i grong khyer lta bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

e ma bdag la nyer 'khor ba'i// blun zhen dad par rlom pa yi// lan chags 'dod pa bskang phyir du// bla ma lha yi zhal mthong zhing*// ngo mtshar nyams snang byung tshul dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs mthong skye ba yi// dran snang mdo tsam 'di lta ste// khyed cag da lta gsung 'phros la// ma yi mngal du gnas pa'i tshe// la las gnyid dang mtshungs pa na// tshor ba'ang rmi lam lta bur 'dod// 'ga' res brgyal stabs yin pas na// tshor ba ci yang med par sgrub// de ltar blun gtam 'ol tshod de// rgyal ba'i gsung dang cung ma mthun// 'dra dpyad 'ol tshod mi dgos par// kho bos dran pa 'di ltar yod// zla ba bdun brgyad lon nas ni// shin tu tshor ba rags par snang*// tsha grang zas skom byed las kyis// grang dro'i rnam pa'ang dpag med 'byung*// ma yi rtsed dga' mchong rgyug dang*// sdigs sogs sdod tshul nyes pa la'ang*| |bskal pa chags 'jig byas so snyam// brag dbar btsir dang ri yis mnan// gnam sa 'khrugs 'dra'i sdug bsngal yod// ma bu gnyis ka skye ba yi// ngal dub dran yang snying rlung ldang*// bdag la de tsam byung min te// tshor ba'i sde la brten pa yi// ma 'gag snang bar ci yang yod| |byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams// bsam bzhin srid pa bzhes tshul la// sus kyang 'gran dang cha bzhag med// la la brdzus te sprul pa'ang yod// de 'dra'i rigs kyi skyes chen la// skye ba snga phyi'i phreng ba yang*// kha sang de ring kha nyin bzhin// thugs rje'i mdzad phrin ji snyed pa// ma 'dres so sor gsal zhes grags// bdag lta'i blo dman rtsod dus kyi// 'dren pa'i tshul 'dzin tha shal la// de tsam spros pa med mod kyang*| |rags rim bsdus te 'chad kyis nyon// bdag nyid byis pa chung ngu la// bshes gnyen 'o zho 'thung ba dang*// dgod 'dzum rkang lag g.yab pa shes// gtsang btsog blang dor ngo tshas dben// smra brjod mi shes nye ring bral// lhug par gang dgar nyal ba'i tshe| |rgyun du bud med rgyan ldan ma// bzhin bzang byams pa'i ngang tshul can// ma bas lhag du brtse ba zhig

/nyams dang rmi lam mngon sum du| |ma ma'i tshul du skyong ba yod// brtse ldan ye shes ḍā ki ma// su zhig yin ni cha ma mchis// de min gzhan yang mdzes ldan ma// nyin bzhin bdag la lta byed cing*// mu men byu ru'i phyag skor sogs// bskor zhing bskor zhing spyo bar mdzad// lus grib bzhin du 'brang ba yod// phyis su brtag na bstan srung ma// chos kyi sgrol ma yin par go// gzhan yang bla ma lha yi rigs// brtse ldan thugs rjes skyong ba yang*// pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs rje'i bdag /ma nges cha lugs cir snang yang*// yang yang byams brtses bdag la gzigs// srung ba sngags kyi zegs ma des// lan cig min par 'thor 'thor nas// bar chad bdud las rgyal bar mdzad// sngon gyi las 'brel ci 'dra yang*// drang srong chen po rā hu la// me dang du ba byis pa'i gzugs// nges med cir yang ston zhing 'khor// rang lo gsum tsam nye ba'i tshod// rgyun du snang ba'i 'char tshul la// bdag ni 'jig rten bya bas dben// yeng med ri la sdod pa yi// 'dzin med spyod pa lhag par skyong*// yeng med sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i// snang ba rgyun du 'char ba'i tshe| |chos kyi rgyal pos dbu mdzad nas// nye bar 'khor ba'i ma rgan sogs// drag zhan bar ma thams cad kyis// 'di na yeng med ngang du gnas// sngon gyi bag chags la brten nas| |bsgoms pas 'khor yug 'da' bar gleng*// kun gyis sgom chen 'bod pa na// byis rgyu langs pas skyengs snang byed// rang bzhin rgyun du rtsed grogs la// rang dang na tshod mnyam pa yi// bu mo lha sras rgyan phreng can// bdag gi bsam pa shes pa zhig /ka ca'i rdzas rnams gang dgos pa// bsam ma thag tu 'jog len sogs| |thogs med rgyun du g.yog byed tshul// bdag la glo bur gzhan gyi rkyen// byung tshe 'ja' bzhin yal ba yod// nga nyid de yi phyir 'brangs te// gzhon nu'i bshes gnyen gsor ba byed// gcig pur bdag ni dgod pa dang*// dal bar rtse na thams cad kyis// rgyus steng nas ni 'jog dgos so// rgyun du rtsed grogs gcig rang ste// res 'ga' mang du 'du ba yod| |lo grangs bzhi tsam yin nam snyam// dgong zhig nyi ma bzhud mtshams su// rtse bar ka bzhi'i nyi 'od na// yab rje rgyal ba'i sku pang du// bdag nyid gan rkyal gnas pa'i mkhar| |he ru ka yi dkyil 'khor zhig

/gdugs dkar bzhin du 'khor ba mjal// tshad rgyal nga ros myos pa nas// ya ki nam mkhar 'khor ba yi// dkyil 'khor lha dang bcas snang ba| |nga la da lta dgos so zhes// mgul la 'chang zhing zhus pa'i tshe// bzhad mo chen po 'khrol bzhin par// khyod min su la'ang mi sbyin mod// da lta gar yod ltos dang gsungs| |blta rgyu nam mkha'i rang bzhin no// lan cig rtse ba'i mchod khang nang*// gcig pur rtse zhing yod pa'i mdun// chas gos dkar ba'i bzhin bzang zhig /rin chen las grub prog zhu gsol// lta bas mi ngom gus tshul can// thal mo sbyar nas yun ring bsdad// phyi 'gros 'dzum dang bcas nas thal// ci ltar yin gyi gnas tshul rnams// brtse ldan yab rjer zhus pa'i tshe// gter sgrom gnas pa'i sman btsun yin// snga dro nga yi mdun na'ang byung*// gsungs shing bdag la byams pa yi// gzigs shing mgo la phyag gis byil// der 'dus ban skyes mang ba la// nyid rang sku na phra ba'i dus// lha dang bla ma yi dam sogs// zhal mchog mthong tshul mdor bsdus gnang*// phag lo gsar pa'i dge mtshan du// thugs rje can gyi sku yi drung*// che btsun ldan pa mang po dang*// ban skyes mang po gral la 'khod// nged cag sku mched rnam gnyis kyang*// rje yi g.yas g.yon khri la 'khod// bza' btung longs spyod du ma dang*| |skyid mgur chos bro glu gzhas sogs// bsam brjod yul las 'das pa bgyis// grol la nye ba'i mdun mtshams su// drang srong du ba mjug ring de// me rlung 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil na// khru ma phu yis btab 'dra'i gzugs// rin chen du mas brgyan pa zhig /ma nges grangs 'das 'khor gyis bskor// mdun thad mkha' lam khengs pa mthong*// bdag gi spyan lam phab ma thag /khro mig mkhar gzigs 'di skad gsungs// pad+ma'i bka' bzhin mi bsgrub la// bstan pa'i srung skyob rgyang bsrings nas// lto phyir snyegs pa ngo rang tsha// zhes gsungs ljags chab mkha' la 'thor// 'dir tshogs skyid la yengs pa nas// gtor bsngos phyis pa snyegs 'dug gsungs// mi mang der tshogs thams cad kyis| |me dpung mkha' la gtor 'dra mthong*// lan cig zhal ngo yongs rdzogs kyis// mtshungs med thugs rje'i mnga' bdag che// dharma'i mtshan can de yi drung*// tshe sring dbang bskur brgya rtsa zhus// mdun gyi tshe chang ka pā lar// tshe dpag dngos su bzhugs pa mjal// de 'dra'i rigs kyi ya mtshan can// yon tan bgrangs pas ga la lang*// lha dang mkha' 'gro chos nyan dang*// sde brgyad 'dre gdon mi min tshogs// skar tshogs bzhin du 'dus pa la// ngo mtshar bdud rtsis tshims mdzad cing*// rang rang srog snying 'bul ba sogs// dbye zhing phye ste smras pa na// brgyad khri bzhi stong nyung ngur byed// 'on kyang khyed cag dris pa'i lan// nga yis mjal ba mdor bsdus 'chad// rtse ba chos kyi pho brang du// skal ldan las 'phro ldan pa dang*| |'gro ba lha mir bcas pa la// bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du// smin grol bdud rtsi'i dga' ston gyis// yongs su smin par mdzad pa'i tshe// dpa' bo lha yi ging chen rnams| |skal dman dam nyams tshe srog la// spyi nor bzhin du bgos pa dang*// gnod byed sman gyi gegs la sogs// rdo rje'i tsha tshas skrod byed cing*// dkyil 'khor lha yi gzhal med la| |ma dang mkha' 'gro mchod cing bstod// dmu thag tshon skud gzungs thag la// dpa' bo'i tshogs rnams gar byed cing*// yid 'ong glu rol du mas mchod// byin chen 'bebs tshe nyin bzhin yang*// de 'dra'i rigs kyi ngo mtshar can// ya mtshan sna tshogs byung ba dang*// lha klu mi min chos nyan gyis// sa dang bar snang khengs par gnas// thams cad rje la zhus pa'i tshe// dgongs shing thugs la mnga' na yang*// ma dag skye 'gro'i snang ba la// shong bar dka' phyir bka' bkyon tshul// bdag la 'bur du gzigs nas su// lkugs pa khyod rang mig mthong yin// yang na 'khrul lam cha ci yod// nga la lha yi chos nyan sogs// 'dus pa'i nus ldan ma yin gsungs// de tshe bdag la 'ga' zhig gis| |chos rje 'di yis nyin re bzhin// mig mthong sna tshogs byas so zer// me tog sna lnga'i char pa dang*// 'ja' tshon gur dang rol mo'i sgra// dri zhim spos kyi ngad ldang zhing*| |nyams 'bar gar dang glu len sogs// rang rang snang ba'i 'char sgo re// ma nges so sor byung ba la// thams cad mig mthong ga la yin// rgyal ba de yi mthu las te// ya mtshan sus kyang bgrang ma nus// so sor yus pas rang rang bden// las sgrib can la ci cha yod// skyabs mchog de yi mtshan tsam yang*// thos pas ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa las| |skyob ces pad+mas yang yang bsngags// bdag ni lo grangs bdun la nye// 'bri lugs rkang gi rim pa bslabs// nangs shig nyi ma shar ri yi// rtser thon 'od zer 'phro ba'i sner| |bcom ldan 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog

/zhal bzhi bcu gnyis phyag ldan pa// ma 'dres phyag mtshan thams cad kyang*// bris 'dra yum dang mnyam par bzhengs// gar dgu'i nyams ldan gzi 'od can// dpa' bo 'jigs dus gdan la 'gying*// ngo mtshar yi dam zhal mthong yang*// na so phra bas lha yi ngo*// rjes su bris thang dkyil nas 'phrod// srod cig zhing skyong gshar ba'i mdun// yum chen si na ra ma de// gcer bu stag sham khro mig can// dmar ser ral pa rgyab du snyil// gar nyams ldan pa mtho gang tsam// phyed skyil tri shūl 'dzin pa la// spre'u gnyis kyis mtha' brten la// 'od kyi khang bur bzhugs pa mjal// 'phral du yul gyi dkar phyogs kyang*// lha rje dkar po la sogs pa// mang dag ya mtshan cher snang yang*// dgos chung yi ger 'jigs nas bzhag /glang lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i// yar tshes bzang po'i bcu yi nub// bdag ni gnyid mthug 'dam du byings// 'khrul gzhi can gyi 'khrul snang la// snga gong cha rgyus ye med pa'i// lha'am yang na rgyal ba'i zhing*// yul gyi bkod pa ya mtshan can// sgyu ma'i skyes bus byas 'dra ba// sa gzhi sngo zhing snum bag ldan| |ljon shing dri ldan sman ljongs khrod// bung ba khu byug snyan cing des// bar mtshams rtswa dang me tog khrod// spu sdug ri dwags rtse zhing rgyug /gcan gzan khro ba spang nas mnal// pad+mas khengs pa'i mtsho nang du// chu bya'i tshogs rnams bag phebs shing*// ngang ngur des pa'i gsung snyan 'khrol// glo bur dus kyang rol mo'i sgra// nam mkha'i khams gang phyogs mtshams med// ya mtshan rmad byung 'di 'dra bdog /shin tu yangs pa'i nor 'dzin dbus// brag dkar rdo rje spungs 'dra'i rtser// 'ja' tshon bla bre bris pa 'dra| |me tog sna lnga'i char chen dang*// bkra shis brgyad dang rin chen bdun// nor bu'i rigs dang mchod pa'i rdzas// 'dod yon sna lnga thams cad kyang*// ngang gis sa dang bar snang khengs| |ci 'dod 'byung ba'i dpag bsam shing*// kha dog gcig tu ma nges pa'i// lo ma me tog 'bras bu can// phyogs rnams kun tu mdzes par khyab// lha yi bu dang bu mo'i gzugs| |rin chen rgyan ldan rol gar mkhan// dril bu g.yer kha'i gdu bu can// kun kyang yid 'phrog mdzes tshul ldan// ngag tshig des pa'i mchod bstod ni// pi waṃ gling bu'i sgra dang bcas// rgyun mi 'chad cing bsngags pa byed// mchod rten shing drung lo ma'i khyim// brag skyibs brag steng thams cad na'ang*// rnal 'byor pho mo mang dag cig

/rang gi rang bzhin la rtog cing*// snying po'i don min mi sems pa// g.yo 'gul med par gnas pa dang*// rang bzhin bzang po'i spyod tshul can// la la gar dang la las glu// stag sham rus pa'i rgyan ldan pa// la las mi rkang gling bu sgyur// he ru ka pa'i brtul zhugs can// dpa' bo dpa' mo bye ba'i tshogs// sna tshogs zas mchog shing 'bras dang*// ro mchog ldan pa'i tshogs rdzas ni| |ma tshang med de ngo mtshar gnas// dpal ldan lha yi zhal zas dang*// sman mchog 'bras nas gro sogs kyi// zhal zas rnam pa mang po dang*// de bzhin mi rigs srog chags rigs| |bye ba sa ya'i sha sna dang*// rkang klad rus pa phung por byas// sman las byas pa'i bdud rtsi dang*// a mṛ ta dang rak+ta'i tshogs/ bdud rtsi'i rigs kyang bgrang bar bka'// la lar sman mchog nyid rang las// byas pa'i kha zas btung ba yang*// lce yi dbang po tshim par snang*// de 'dra'i tshogs rdzas dpag med la// dpa' bo gar byed shigs se shig /dpa' mo glu len kyu ru ru// gtsang dang mi gtsang gnyis 'dzin bral// thams cad bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs// bdag la mgron gyi tshul du bgyis// sngon du tshims par byas nas ni// yongs kyi dga' mgur spyod pa mdzad// lhag pa phud dang bar pa gsum// so sor kha kha khā hi ni// sngags kyi sgra ni brjod ma thag /so so nas kyang rang nor bzhin// blangs nas so so nyid du rol// de nas 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams kyang*// rang rang rdzu 'phrul chas la bzhugs// bkra shis smon lam brda yi glu// dir dir so sor gyes nas song*// bdag gis phyogs kun mig g.yas kyis// 'gro ba bsam pa skyes gyur kyang*// nam mkha'i mtha' bzhin pha mtha' yas// slar yang zhib tu brtag pa na// skad dang mgo bcos lus rgyan gzugs// mi mthun skye 'gro du ma'i khrod// bdag nyid gcig pu grogs dang bral// 'di 'dra su yi yul yin snyam// skye 'gro du ma'i 'byung ba la// mi sdug 'dre srin sprin bzhin g.yo// bya dang ce spyang hab sha len// la la 'bod 'ded 'dur 'gying byed// la la gshur zhing la la lding*// 'ga' zhig gdug rtsub khro gnyer ston// la las la la gsod cing gtub// sha khrag dron mor longs spyod rjes// rus pa'i phung pos gar mkhan bgyid// ro langs 'byung po'i cho 'phrul snang*// bdag kyang bred pa'i snang ba shar// so sgra sgrog cing rngam rngam ltar// ha ha hi hi zer cing rgyug

/la las dmod bor g.yang gzhi rdeb// lan chags sbur ma bzhin du 'khor// sha khrag skyo mar byas nas rol// de sogs skyi g.ya' bye ba mthong*| |bdag gis 'jigs pa ma bzod de// skya khras zin pa'i byi'u phrug bzhin// sgyid ldan 'dar zhing 'di skad shor// bdag gis rnam dkar lhag bsam rgyun du bzung*// srid pa thams cad du yang gzhan phan bgyis// byang chub sems mchog rlabs chen rnam pa gnyis// rgyun du bsgoms shing gzhan phan 'dor ma myong*// rin chen skyabs mchog gsum gyi bstan la zhugs| |lan cig min par srid mtshor bying ba yi// mgon med ma gyur 'gro 'di bsgral bya'i phyir// theg chen dkon mchog skyabs 'gro gtong ma myong*// las kyi sa bon dkar nag ci 'dra ba// 'bras bu de yang ma 'dres so so ste// rang gzhan gnyis phung las ngan tshabs po che// lan cig tsam yang bsags pa dran ma myong*// dal ba mi yi yul du sdod bzhin pa| |las 'bras rtsis gdab de la 'bung bzhin pa// rdzus skyes bzhin du deng 'dir bdag mchis pa// bdud kyis bslus sam las 'bras ci zhig kye// bdag gi 'dren pa chos rgyal phun tshogs des// dus gsum sa ler mkhyen pas gzigs sam ci// skyid sdug ci byung legs nyes ci 'dra yang*// dkon mchog gsum min skyabs gzhan btsal du med// brtse ba'i bdag nyid can rnams dus la bab// thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs la mthu dpung bskyed// bshas rar gshed mas bzung ba'i sems can la// srog bslu byas bzhin byams mgon rnams kyis skyongs// bdag gis tshe rabs mchod cing bsnyen pa yi// lhag pa'i lhar bzung yi dam gang yin dag /nga 'dra mgon med gzhan yang su mchis pa// rings par glog 'gyu lta bus da skyobs mdzod// ces sogs brjod cing bos bos mthar// ngal dub 'gyel la thug pa dang*// ci byas brtol med gyur pa'i tshe// brag ri rin chen spungs 'dra'i rtser| |bcom ldan dpal chen he ru kaḥ

/dpa' bo mtshan dpe'i gzi brjid can// zhal gcig phyag gnyis gar nyams ldan// skam rlon mgo phreng rin chen rgyan// stag sham glang po'i stod g.yogs gsol// bskal pa'i me yi klong na 'gying*// bdag nyid skyob pa'i phyag rgya can// g.yas pa rdo rje nam mkhar phyar// g.yon pa dril 'dzin sdigs mdzub rtser// thog ser me yi tsha tsha 'phro// oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ// ces pa'i gsung gi nga ro yang*// 'brug stong dus gcig ldir bar snyam// gnod byed de dag thams cad kyang*// la la rengs shing la la 'gyel| |gdug pa'i ce spyang de dag kyang*// gcong gcong 'byin cing gdug sems bor// 'jigs dang bral ba'i snang ba thob// tham thum gnyid sad dus gcig 'grig /de 'dra de dag thams cad ni// ma 'dres so sor gsal bar yang*// bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes pa yi// bshes gnyen sangs rgyas rin chen drung*// mdang sum gnyid pa'i 'khrul snang la// 'di 'dra ci zhes zhib bsnyad tshe// khyod kyi lhag pa'i lha mchog ste// bcom ldan 'khor lo sdom pa 'dra// ya mtshan tshogs la rol ba yi// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i mdun sa der// mthong snang ro langs ce spyang sogs// ya mtshan dur khrod ci 'dra yang*// skyob pa'i lha mchog chen po de// bcom ldan dpa' bo gcig pa red// bsnyen cing sgrub pa bgyis pa na// mchog thun dngos grub myur du 'byung*// de 'dra 'phrul snang ga la yin// zhes sogs gsungs shing dgyes par mdzad// skabs zhig 'od zer dmar nag klong*// ma he glang rgod bsnol ba'i steng*// phyag rgya zil gnon 'gying bag can// rgyun ring bar du gsal bar mjal// na phra mthong myong med pa nas// bdag la thugs brtse che ldan pa// bkra shis phun tshogs rgyal ba'i sras// 'gro mgon skyes mchog de drung du// da nangs gdugs kyi snga dro la// ya mtshan can gyi lha zhig mjal// zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad// dur khrod rus pa sprul la sogs// zo ris thal chen stag sham dang*// mgo phreng rlon pa'i do shal 'phyangs// 'khor lo ral gri rdo rje bsnams// g.yas gsum phyag nas 'dzin pa la// g.yon gyi dang pos lcags kyu bsnams// 'og mas sdigs mdzub mdzad pa la// bar pas gtun phug yas rgyag 'dra// 'dzin pa'i lha de su zhig zhus// bzhad mo mdzad cing tshe bdag gi// tsaka li bsnams nas 'di yin gsungs// de 'dra'i rigs can chung ngu'i dus// lha dang phyag mtshan yig sna mang*// rang lo dgu tsam yin pa'i dus// grib cham la brten thu bar na// glud dang grib mdos btang ba'i tshe// mgo med dmar zag rta pho la// ban gzugs 'jigs pa'i cha byad can// rgyal po'i tshul du 'gyings nas zhon// yul 'dre pho mo mang po dang*// grib bdag rgyal ltogs grangs med pa// dpung chen glud mdos blangs pa'i rjes// gnod sbyin dpon po rtsi dmar ba// gro sngon g.yu yi rnga rngog can// rmed gong rin chen gser gyis brgyan// khro gnyer am gtsigs sdang mig bgrad// mdung dmar 'debs pa'i phyag rgya can// khyi dmar rol tu khrid pa zhig

/gnod byed gdon tshogs 'ded pa dang*// khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba| |sgrib med shel gong 'dra ba'i sku// ral gri gdengs shing hūm̐ sgra sgrog /rdor zhags 'phen zhing 'gying bag can// gnod byed tshogs la sdigs pa dang*// rig 'dzin sngags pa'i cha byad can// phod chen leb rgan snam sbyar gsol// phyogs mtshams kun tu gzigs pa yis// phur pa sgril zhing dmod pa rjod// bdag srog 'don pa'i khag chen khur// lan cig yang ri sgar chen gyi// lo gsum mtshams grwa brje len dus// bla dpon dge 'dun stong phyed dang*// phye btsun khri phrag 'tshogs pa la// mtshungs med dkon mchog rin chen gyis// zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor zhal 'byed mdzad// 'di phyir dge ba'i zab dgu 'thung*// bde skyid rdzogs ldan dus bzhin spyad// lha yi me tog mchod sprin yang*// nyin mtshan khor yug mtshams med pas// grol ba'i nyin par gyi nas kyang*// rnam dkar 'brel ba yod tsam bzhag /pad 'byung zhi ba'i dbang zhig bgyis// bar snang me tog 'ja' 'od sogs| |ji bzhin ma nyams mdangs bkra bzhin// ya mtshan rdul gnon char yang bab// 'dus chen snang ba chos la bsgyur// rang gi mdun gyi mkha' lam na// gu ru rat+na mtho gang tsam| |rgyun ring bar du mjal ba byung*// grol ba'i phyi nas mu mthud de// dam pa mkhan chen rnam 'joms kyis// thos pas grol ba'i sgrub chen btsugs// rdul tshon dkyil 'khor bkra ba'i steng*// dra phyed tshon skud sna lnga de// 'ja' tshon lta bur 'dug pa'i nang*// yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// gar stabs |rje blon 'bangs 'khor thams cad kyis// dgyes pa'i zhal mchog yongs su bstan// gnas mchog bkra shis do chen yang*// gnas chen dag pa shrī ltar// gnas tshul bkra shis sgo mang du// gnas nas 'dug pa kho bos mthong*// de nub dag pa'i gnyid snang la// gu ru rat+na'i mtshan can drung*// gdams zab tshe dbang nod pa'i tshul// logs su yi ger bkod nas yod// byang chub sems dpa' mang po yi// dben gnas se mo do chen de// mthong ba'i mod la yid kyang g.yos// bdag gi'ang bla ma'i rnam par thar// tshul bzhin bskyangs pa'i dran snang gsal// ti se la phyi tsā ri sogs// gnas mchog chen po thams cad du// kho bos kyang ni snying po yi// don bsam bstan la bya ba mchog

/yang yang bgyis pa'i spro dga' de| |srid rtse'i bar du 'gyur snyam shar// phyi nangs nyi ma shar dros la// dkar gsum mngar sogs zas kyi sna// ma tshang med de mtsho la phul// 'khrul gzhis g.yos pa'i mig lam der| |lbu phreng sna tshogs pad+mar gyur// 'od 'phros mtsho de khyab par snang*// mdzes ldan bzhin bzang na chung zhig gser mdog nya chen yor mo la// gser gyi sga srab nor bus brgyan| |gser mthur shin tu ring ba'i sne// gus tshul ldan pas bdag la bsrings// bdag gis kyang rang gi bzhon pa las// myur du bab ste len gyi tshul// de la byin pa'i snang nyams shar| |nye 'khor gsum la phar bltas tshe// khrus kyi bya ba byed cing 'dug /gzhan pa'i rje dpon mi mang kun// rta zhon so sor 'gro bar brtsam// de mtshams bdag gi bsam yul la| |pad+mas khengs pa'i mtsho nang 'dir// lha yi btsun mo'i zhal dkyil dang*// ya mtshan gser nya ri phran tsam// rin chen brgyad ldan 'di 'khyug pa'i// cha shas tsam yang mi mthong ba| |skye bo 'di dag har bltas kyang*// ma rig bad kan sgrib g.yogs can// snying brtses bskyangs pa'i yul du rig /de tshe bzhin bzang 'dzum ldan des// bdag bsam shes pas legs par 'dud/ /thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad do// bdag cag srid mtshor chags pa'i mig nad can// bem po'i rang bzhin skye bo'i tshogs 'di dag /sngon nas goms pa'i bsags sbyang chung ba nas// rgyal kun mtshan dpe'i yon tan kun bstan kyang*// rang rgyud ma dag kun kyang skyon can te// dung gi rang bzhin ser nag can du rtog /dag pa'i snang bar dag pa 'bum 'char zhing*// gnyan gyi rje bo rgyal ba thod dkar yang*// khyod kyi che ba'i yon tan mthong ba'i mod// zhi ba'i 'dzum mdangs rgyas pa'i zhal mchog bstan// dgos 'dod yid bzhin nor gyi gter mdzod phog /dregs pa'i 'khor gyis gdug pa'i sems nyid bor// sngon dus kho mo'i bsti gnas se mo dor// dam tshig chen pos rjes su bzung bzhin dgongs| |de nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar// 'dren mchog khyod la gus pas skyabs su mchi// zhes zer gus pas thal mo sbyar// phyi 'gros tshul du mi snang ngo*// 'ba' rom gnas kyi yang snying mchog

/rdza del rin chen spungs pa der// gnas zhag bgyis pa'i tho rangs char// khams dwangs dbang po gsal ba'i mdun// dar ma dbang phyug dge bsnyen che| |lha yi mchog gyur gang ba bzang*// mi dkar rta dkar 'gying bag can// ba dan dkar po srid rtser sgreng*// dkar po lha yi 'khor tshogs kyis/ /nya dang gnam stong tshes brgyad la| |bsnyen gnas sdom pa blangs pa'i mjug /mang ma phyir gshegs rje bo des// 'di nas 'dam stod sa yi cha// thang lha'i lha 'khor sum brgya po// mthong ba'i ri la bsang mchod dang*| |rten 'brel rim 'gror gang che rnams// khyod kyis byas nas hor rje yi// rigs brgyud 'dzin pa'i dpag bsam la// mnga' thang rlabs kyi yal 'dab 'phyur// chab srid dge ba'i pad+mo 'dzum// the'u dri zas 'dogs par snang*// smin legs chos sgron nyid la chol// ring nas tshad pas myos rnams kyang*// bsil thob ngal gsos dbugs 'byin byed// zhes sogs do dam mang dag bsgos// bsgos bzhin 'dam du phyin nas cing*// khor tsha'i srid la 'phel ldan dang*// 'jig rten dge zhing bde ba'i phyir// sa gnad mchod rten byin chen rnams| |zhig pa gsos shing rab gnas bskyar// byin chen mchod rten nag 'bal der// gu ru mthing nag rdo rje gdengs// phur bu bsgril zhing shis brjod mdzad// mchod rten dmar 'bal drung du yang*// gtum po lag na rdo rje mjal// skye mang rjes su bzung ba'ang dran// 'dam lung sa yi khyon yangs der// gnyan rigs bye ba dgu khri'i tshogs// byang sems nam mkha'i snying po yi// thugs rje'i zer gyis gang bar mngon// gzhan yang byang rgyud lha rigs dag /mo nom la sogs mtha' yas kyis// dge bsnyen sdom brtson nod pa sogs// bgrang yas mchis kyang yi ger 'jigs// hor zla dgu pa'i nang du slebs// kho bo mdo khams phyogs su chas// hor rje dpon blon brgya phrag gis// 'dus chen lha ri bar du bskyal// chen po khor tsha g.yu rgyal des// gdung ba'i sems kyis ma phod nas// mig nas mchi ma g.yo bzhin du// 'dar 'dar skad dang bcas nas ni// 'jig rten snang ba'i bstun tshul dang*// bya bzhag bkod gnas ji snyed cig

/brtse ba'i sems kyis rgyas par smed// 'bral mi phod cing 'ju zhing 'tham// mi bzang de dag thams cad kyang*// skyo ba'i gnang tshul du ma ston// a ce'ang mchi mas brnangs bzhin du// yab rje rgyal ba'i mtshan nas 'bod// thugs rje can gyis srungs shig gsung*// shin tu brtse ba'i gdung tshul ston// kho bo'ang yid ni cung zad g.yos// 'on kyang dpon la 'di skad zhus// nged cag gang du 'gro yang rung*// thugs kyi ngal ba ring du dor// nyid rang sku yi rim 'gro la// brtson pa lan cig min pa mdzod// khyod la 'jig rten srid 'dzin dang*// chab srid mnga' 'bangs mtha' khyon ngos// mtha' dmag 'jigs pa nyid rang tshe// kho bos khag chen 'khur zhes gyes// de nyin rngod pa'i ja 'dren dang*// 'gom du 'bod mi dus gcig 'grig /rten 'brel brtag pa'i chos nyid des// rngod smad rgyal gyi brag rtsar 'byor// skal ldan 'bum phrag phyed gsum la| |sgrub pa bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor du// smin grol dbang rnams bskur ba'i tshe// me tog char dang 'ja' 'od 'khrugs// chab rom chur zhu ne'u gseng sngo// yang dag bum pa 'phar ba sogs// pra rtags gzhung mthun ya mtshan ltas// bgrang bar mi spobs dpag med byung*// nyer bdun srod kyi thun mtshams su// tham thum gnyid pa'i 'khrul snang la// dkon mchog pad+mo yin zhes pa'i// ye shes ḍā ki'i cha byad can// 'od zer dkar po'i sna lam nas// 'jam tshig dal bus 'di skad do// kun bzang rgyal ba'i pho brang du// rig 'dzin skyes mchog chen po rnams// smin grol gsang sngags zab dgur spyod// khyed kyang 'byon par spro 'am gsungs// spro zhus phyi bzhin 'brangs nas song*// rdo rje'i brag ri 'jigs rung zhing*// dmar smug 'chong mdog brjid bag can// chos kyi 'byung gnas brtsegs 'dra'i dbus// gzhal med khang chen rgya khyon bkod// bsam brjod yul las 'das pa'i nang*| |'od lam de yang thal gyis snang*// rin chen las grub khri steng du// rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po de// rig 'dzin sngags kyi cha lugs can// lta bas chog mi shes pa'i sku// mtshan dpe ldan pa'i g.yas phyogs na// bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du// lha tshogs dngos su bkra bar snang*// rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams kyang*// rdo rje'i gsung mchog 'dzab dbyangs ni// 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra ltar grags// thams cad dgyes pa'i zhal 'dzum dang*// rnam 'gyur bdag la ston bzhin du// rang rang gral la 'khod par brtsam// bdag gis gus pas phyag bgyis shing*// dkyil 'khor chen po'i mdun thad du// dang po nyid nas rang nyid kyi// yin pa 'dra ba'i khri stan la// dbang zhu gtso bo'i tshul du 'khod// gu ru chos kyi rgyal po des// gsang sngags che ba'i yon tan dang*// bde gshegs lha yi dkyil 'khor cher// bskal par bsags sbyang las smon can// skal ldan skyes chen ma lags pas//

u dum wa ra'i me tog ltar// skal dman kun gyis mthong ba'am// thos pa nyin skar dag dang mtshungs// zhes gsungs dbang rnams rim bzhin mdzad// dmod bor me tog dor ba dang*| |lha yi rnam dag bstan pa'i skabs// gtso 'khor de dag thams cad kyang*// sgrib med shel gyi mchod sdong bzhin// dpa' bo gar dgu'i nyams ldan rnams// gsal la ma 'dres chas brgyad 'chang*// ha hūm̐ gad rgyang chen po sgrog /der 'dus bdag cag gsang ba'i mtshan// che mchog las 'brel rtsal du btags// phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang bskur rnams// shin tu rgyas par kun la gnang*// bka' gtad shis pa brjod pa'i mthar// thams cad so sor gyes pa'i mjug /bdag dang bshul lam ring dag la// 'gro ba'i bsam pa sems 'phreng can| |gcong gcong nad kyis zin pa ltar// gyur tshe rje btsun chen po des// slar yang dpal chen che mchog gi// skur bstan nas ni 'di skad gsungs// bu bu ma 'phreng yid kyis 'di ltar zungs// dus ngan snyigs ma lnga bdo'i bskal ba la// bla ma tshul 'chos mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis// chos min chos su bstan nas dad ldan slu// de dus kun bzang gsang ba'i yang mchog gces// nam mkha'i dbus su glu dbyangs sna tshogs len// rgya mtsho'i dkyil du gar mkhan rol rtsed sgyur// byis pa chung ngus zlos gar phyir log sgyur| |ma 'das 'das dus pha bong chab rom bzhu// ri yi ngos nas lcags spre rak+ta 'gyed// ces sogs gzhan yang zhal ta dang*// lung bstan gsung mchog mang yod kyang*// blo dman yid gnyis spong phyir bzhag /skye dang skye ba thams cad du// mi 'bral rjes su 'dzin pa yi// gsung gi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzod// bla ma yi dam chos skyong kun// 'dus pa'i zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs// thung min legs pa'i smon lam btab// sring gcig ye shes ḍā ki des// sngar bzhin slar yang rang gnas bskyal// gnyid sad dgung thun 'jug la nye| |rtogs ldan bkra shis bsod nams kyis// bskul ngor 'di thad lhug par yang*// zur du yig chung yod pas nges// slar yang rngod stod gangs shod du// khri phrag 'dzoms pa'i skal ldan ngor// bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho yi// dbang dang skye bdun sgrub pa sbrel// bum pa 'gul zhing ril bu 'phur// 'dzad med gter gyi bang mdzod ltar// spyad cing ril bu 'phel bar snang*| |bkra shis gangs kyi ra ba na// dag pa sems kyi 'char sgo la// gra phu lha yi pho brang cher// gnas kyi gtso chen lte ba rnams// sgo 'byed rten 'brel byung gyur kyang*// rgyu rkyen phra mo'i phyi bshol gyis// kho bo slar yang nyi zla bzhin// mdo khams phyogs su 'char bar mngon// rnam rgyal dgon gyi bla brang du// gnam lcags mdog can a tsa ra// mi snying rkang gling thogs pa zhig

/ma g.yel dus kyi lto slong zer// ci ming gang la 'ong zhes dris// kha'u'i brag rdzong gnas nas 'ongs// tsa turmu kha bya ba yin// dam tshig dbang gis khyod phyir 'brangs| |bar chad nyams grib sel ba dang*// dus gtor len phyir 'ongs zhes zer// ya mtshan cher mngon 'di skad bsnyad// khyod kyis bdag la bsrung skyob pa'i// sngon dus las bzang ji ltar 'brel// da lta bsnyen sgrub dus gtor sogs// khyod la sger dmigs med mod kyang*// lha mir yong ba'i rgyu rkyen dang*// bar chad ci 'dug sel thabs ci// da nas khyod gsol bsten mchod na// bsten pa'i thabs tshul smros dang smras// mdun du dal phab 'di skad zer// khyod sngon rgya gar lho phyogs si ta'i yul// mun pa drag po zhes pa'i dur khrod du// rnal 'byor rak+ṣa tsaṇ+ḍa zhes bya ba// zhal bzhi mgon po'i dngos grub brnyes par gyur// de nas rgyud de slar yang gnyan lo yi// slob ma'i mchog gyur rā dza'i mtshan 'dzin pa// gnyan gyi mgon por gus blo ldan na yang*// tshe ni bar du gcod pa'i dbang du song*// de yi rjes su bla ma kha'u pa'i// slob ma grags pa ye shes zhes byar gyur| |kha'u'i brag rdzong dben gnas phug pa ru// khyod kyis bdag la bsnyen zhing lo dgur 'bad// de nas bzung ste skye ba bdun du 'brel// da lta skyu ra'i gdung du khyod gyur mod| |dam tshig dbang gis bdag gis phyi bzhin 'brangs// bar du gcod pa'i rkyen gyur ngas sel mod// khyod kyang shākya'i dge slong bstan 'dzin te// nyams grib dbang gis zhag shas ngal bar snang*// srog la rgol ba'i bar chad dus 'debs pa// nyer lnga'i sa lug li la phyin pa'i dus// shin tu skag pas yid la legs par zungs// lcags sbrul lo pas gnod sems sbyor ngan rtsom// tshe yi 'du byed stor la the tshom dka'// spyod lam gzobs la 'di bzhin rim 'gror 'bungs// gnyen mgon lus grib bzhin du 'khor ba la// gzhung bzhin bla rdo gri snying rten rdzas sogs// zla ba byung ngo cog gi dgu gsum la// dus gtor phul la der dmigs las sbyor gyis// bskang dang mnga' gsol dpal mgon brgyad la'ang dgos| |dge la sbyin sreg bgrang yas bgyis pa na// skag chen de las sgrol te skag chung ni// gnam lo shing lug lcags glang me stag gsum// shar dus gong bzhin slar yang 'bad dgos so// tshe tshad mthar phyin bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal// gnyis 'dzin dor la ji ltar bsgos bzhin nges// bar chad zhi zhing mi mthun phyogs las rgyal// bsam pa'i don bzang brtson pas bdag gis sgrub// bla rdo gri snying rkang gling rten rdzas la// brnyas sems 'bags btsog 'gom g.yab shor gyur na// chos skyong 'khu nad rims sogs 'khor la 'byung*| |phyugs god yong bas shin tu gzab par mdzod// don rnams bsam la brtson 'grus dpag med bskyed// skyabs mchog gsum la gros phug gtad pa na// phun sum tshogs pa'i bdag por 'gyur ba yin// zhes sogs zer ba'i yig chung zhig

/zur du bkod pa yod de mchis// khams stod sa yi thig le'i char// chen po'i gnas gzhi sde steng du// chos rje sku mched dbur bzhugs pa'i// las skal ldan pa mang ba dag /rdo rje phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor du// smin grol dbang gis tshim par byas// mgon po khang du mnga' gsol tshe// chos sgron zhi ba'i zhal mchog mthong*// bdun phrag skye ba'i dran snang dang*// rnam dkar las tshogs mang po zhig /gnas gzhi de tshor bgyis pa'ang dran// kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod de// rdzu 'phrul chas kyi 'phros nas ni// mkha' lam brgyud nas bab 'dra ba// zla dgon kun bzang pho brang cher// las can khri phrag tshogs pa la// thos grol dbang chog rgyas pa btsugs// dge 'dun bcu phrag bdun dag la// chos drug khrid kyis smin par byas// gzhan yang rang rang 'dod mos bstun// dal 'byor yid bzhin gru chen nor| |brten nas srid mtshor brgal nus pa'i/ /dad skal 'dzoms pa'i skyes tshogs la/ /yid bzhin nor mchog lha khrid dang*// rtsa 'dab dang ni 'pho ba sogs// dbang khrid lung sogs mang bgyis mthar// gtsug lag yang steng mgon khang du// bdun phrag mtshams mal bcad pa'i tshe// yar tshes bzang po brgyad kyi nub// bud med lus la smin ma dang*// ag tshom rdzi skra dmar ser 'khyug /gcer bu stag sham rus rgyan can// gar stabs ling ling mdun du byung*// rgya gar dur khrod bsil tshal nas// nā ro chen pos khyod nyid la// shog gsung da lta nga phyir 'brang*// zer ba'i mod nyid skad cig der// dur khrod chen por phyin par gyur// pha bong seng chen bsnol 'dra'i steng*// byang sems ri dwags lpags pa bkal| |paṇa chen nā ro bzhugs pa la// bka' brgyud rgyal ba'i pho khrom dang*// byang sems grub thob rig 'dzin tshogs// khrag 'thung ma hā kā lā'i 'khor// dngos su bkra ba'i mdun du 'byor// rje btsun dzñā na sid+dhi des// gdams pa dmigs rkang 'khrul 'khor rnams// gsal la rgyas pa'i zhal gdams sogs// yid gnyis the tshom chod par gnang*// bdag kyang dga' bde'i dpa' gdeng thob// gtso 'khor de dag thams cad ni// chu dang chu nyid 'phrad pa ltar// bla ma nyid kyi sku ru gyur// gu ru de yang rang nyid dang*// dbyer med nam mkha'i rang bzhin las// 'thib po'i gnyid las langs par gyur// de tshe rang re'i sgar khrod du// 'byor ldan dad can zas dang skom// khong zhugs ma zhu log skran bsags// 'gong pos snying la gtses pa 'gas// gsang sngags zab khu thal dong phos// mched kyi sde dang slob dpon dkrugs// dam tshig sgo nga dron mo de// phyi rtsis ma bltas brag la brdabs| |mi snyan gtam gyis 'dzam gling bkang*// 'byor ldan dad pa gting nas bzlog

/zhen chen khong skran 'cha' ru bcug /mi dge'i phung po ri tsam bsags// de 'dra'i rigs can mang dag gis// rkyen byas yid mug khong nas langs// snyigs dus 'dren pa bdag 'dra'i rigs// gang du gzhan ni yod gyur kyang*// kye ma kye hud snying rje'i yul// rang gis rang la yid phyung nas// 'gro mgon rdo rje rgyal po yi// rin chen mchod sdong byin chen drung*// rang snying rje ba'i smre sngags tshig /yid phyung mig chus brnangs bzhin du// yi ge'i lam nas gsol ba'i tshe// rnam dag lha lam sprin dkar khrod// 'gro mgon chen po rdo rje rgyal// bka' brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor// thugs rje can gyis lung 'di stsal// kye ma skye ba snga ma'i las smon mthus// de yi skye ba phyi ma'i las 'bras sgrub// gnas gzhi 'di la khyod kyang las smon can// nyams pa 'di la sbyin sreg rab gnas bskyor// bka' yi srung ma brgyad la gnyer kha gtod// yang yang gnas dus blo dang bstun pa yi// rgyu skar bdag pos gling bzhi skyong bar mdzod// tsit+ta'i mtshan bzhin 'di la gces dgos gsungs// rdo rje'i gsung bzhin lag tu bstar// gnas mchog chen po rta rnar yang*// 'gro mgon sangs rgyas yel pa yi// sku brnyan 'dra 'bag byin chen la// shis brjod dbang bzhi blangs pa'i mod// zhal sgo'i tshems dkar pad phreng bzhad// khong 'dzum bung ba'i glu dbyangs kyis// bdag gi sgra 'dzin gang bar byas// thugs rje drag po'i tshul mnyes pa// seng chen thugs dam 'bum la sogs| |byin chen khyad 'phags mang dag mjal// yel phug shar gyi dgon pa na// dge slong 'tsho byed gzhon nu yi// sman mchog bdud rtsi sbyor ba des// nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs par mdzad// khams gnas gla ba rkang gcig gi// mdzod kyi sgrub gnas mjal ba na// me tog char dang 'ja' 'od gur/ /kun gyi mig lam snang ba'i khrod/

/gu ru pad+ma rgyal po la| |sras brgyad nye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor// lha phrug mang pos mchod pa mjal// cham stod sa yi thig le na// gsal stong chen po'i sgrub khang mchog /mi g.yel phug ces bya ba ru// tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rdzas rnams bsags// rtsa gsum las byang bgyis pa'i tshe// dar cig zim zim gnyid 'dra la// rang nyid zhig po kha sho de| |yin pa'i nyams kyi snang ba shar// gnas mchog grong gi brag ldebs la// lag g.yas dkyil mdzub rjes kyang yod// rdza bshis rdza mo phug gi mdun// sprul sku chos dbyings rdo rje dang*| |legs tshogs rten 'brel mjal 'dzoms bgyis// de nas byang phyogs spar thang brgyud// 'dan stod brag rtsar 'byor ba'i tshe// chos sgron srid 'dzin tshul mdzad mthar// bam gyi dngos grub brnyes pa'i phug /gting ring zhes par rang nyid kyi// rkang lag gnyis kyi rjes kyang byung*// tsong ngur skyob pa chen po nyid// 'khrungs ltas yan lag brgyad ldan gyi// chu mig rdol dang 'bru drug gi// yi ge rdor sems rang byon sku// dgung lo lnga pa'i zhabs rjes dang*// ra yis drud pa'i sku rjes sogs// ngo mtshar che ba du ma mjal// klung mo che yi brag phug nang*| |zhag tshugs gnas zhag bgyis pa'i tshe// rgyal ba mchog gi zhabs kyi rjes// sngar ma grags pa zhig kyang rnyed// sga stod lha sgra'i sa khongs nas// mkhas pa smṛ ti'i mchod rten drung*| |grub chen brgyad kyi zhal mchog mthong*// glang chen dgon gyi klu bdud la// byang chub sems ldan sdom pa byin// kam po gnas kyi 'phags yul du// rje btsun gar gyi dbang po'i drung*// lugs gnyis dga' bde'i dpal la spyad// byin chen sgrub gnas sku brnyan mjal// byang chub sems bskyed sdom pa mnos// rab kyi stong tshar sgang zhes pa// lha chen bzhag ra bzhugs pa'i mdun// gser phye thang zhes bya ba na// dge 'dun 'brum pa'i nad kyis gtses// khong pa'i snying ltar gces pa yi// ya zung 'jig rten pha rol thal// de tshe phyag rgya zil gnon la// gsol btab srung 'khor sgrub pa bgyis// yi dam lha yi zhal mchog mthong*// rjes bzung lung bstan gnang ba thob// rang nyid lha dang dbyer med rtogs// 'brum bdag dred mo'i lus can sogs// gdug can kun gyis rang gzugs bstan/

/dngos su 'dud cing gus phyag byas// sngar byas las la 'gyod bshags dang*// phyin chad yos lo pa zhig gi// bla srog 'gams zin bskyal rgyu med// de min khyod nyid gar 'byon yul// nged cag gnod pa mi bgyid ces// khas blangs nad kyi nyes pa bral// rgya bod mtshams kyi nad gzhi che// mdo yi mi chen rtswa ra na// dal phab rnam dkar 'phel ba'i mod// mdo grong g.yon gyi bzhag chu'i ngogs// rgya yul gzhi bdag gang po yi// gnas gzhi 'dug pa kho bo bos// longs spyod du mas tshim par byas// slar yang kho bo lo bdun tshun// 'bod pa'i dam lan 'ga' re byas// dge bsnyen sdom pas rjes su bzung*// rgya /stag shar mda' yi yang rtsal ngom// 'jig rten lha mi'i dga' skyid dpal// ma lus 'di na 'dus so snyam// phyug po na khar 'byor ba'i nyin// rje btsun chos dbyings rang grol dang*// gdung 'dzin lcam /dga' sdug bde skyid 'jigs skrag dang*// nye ring byams sdang snang shas kun// thams cad kun byed rang mdangs su// bzhag nas gnyid pa'i tho rangs char// gzhi chen rtse bar yin pa 'dra'i// rnam rgyal khang bzang lta bu'i nang*// seng chen pad zlas brgyan pa'i steng*// chos rgyal phun tshogs thugs rje'i bdag /rin chen rus pa'i rgyan dang bcas| |rdor dril 'dzin cing rdor sems kyi// bzhugs tshul ldan pa'i dbu gtsug steng*// pad+ma 'byung gnas rigs kyi bdag /'od khyim nang du tshon gang pa// zhi tshul 'dzum mdangs ldan pa dang*// g.yas su 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku// ngur smrig rgyal mtshan klubs shing mdzes// g.yon du yum chen g.yang khug de// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i chas rgyan can// byams brtse'i bzhin mdangs 'dzum bcas bzhugs// khri yi gdong du khro bo rgyal// gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogs rnams// sna tshogs 'ja' 'od 'khrugs pa'i klong*| |so sor yang ni rang mdog gyur// rang 'od nyid las grub pa mjal// bdag gi yid mtsho rab g.yos te// dga' ba'i rba rlabs mkha' la 'phyur// srid rtse'ang dma' 'ur byas nas thal// yab yum mi mngon dbyings su gshegs// bdag gis sa mtha' mang nyugs 'khor// rgyun ring lo mang song mod kyang*// thugs rje can rnams nye ring med// sprul pa'i snang brnyan 'di rnams ni// bdag la thugs brtses dgongs so snyam// mi phyed dad pas phyag mang btsal// gdung shugs drag pos 'di skad gsol// bdag ni bsod nams skal ba che| |thugs rje che mgon rnams kyi drung*// rang gzhan srid pa'i ngal dub las// sgrol ba snying po'i chos shig zhu// srid 'dir 'phel 'grib spyod tshul dang*// tshe sring rten 'brel phan byed grogs// srog 'phrog ngan 'gror 'khrid byed pa'i// rigs can skyes bu ci 'dra 'byung*// skye dang skye ba thams cad du// mi 'bral thugs rjes bskyangs pa dang*// tshe 'dir bsam pa'i don bzang rnams// ji ltar 'grub pa'i lung bstan zhu// zhus pas thog mar gu ru rje'i// zhal gyi sgo las 'od zer 'phros// srid gsum 'jig rten gsal bar mdzad// tshangs pa'i mgrin gyis 'di skad gsung*// kye kye/

'khor ba'i chos kun sgyu ma'i rnam rol nyid// mi brtan rnam rol ci yang ston byed cing*// thar pa'i srog gcod bde ba'i lam srang bgegs// byang chub thob pa'i gegs las gzhan med phyir// thams cad sems las byung bar thag chod la// cir snang stong nyid ngang la gzhol nas cing*// kun bzang sems kyi rang zhal mjal bar mdzod// ces gsungs yang ni rje btsun che// chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal 'dzum las// dal 'byor rnyed dka' brnyes kyang myur du 'jig /dkar nag las kyi bde sdug 'bras bu myong*// sdig sgrib dag phyir rdor sems sgom bzlas dang*// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i maṇ+ḍal longs spyod dbul// kun gyi rtsa ba skyabs 'gro'i bslab byar 'bad| |rang rgyud dag phyir bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom// thabs shes dbyer med rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i nang dbus su// rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi bsam rdzogs rim sku| |mtshan nyid bzhi ldan a shad sbar ba las// a haṃ 'bar 'dzag rtsa mdud bzhi bkrol nas// dga' bzhi'i lhan skyes rang snang sgom pa sogs// gtum mo'i rnal 'byor dag la 'bad par mdzod// gnyis snang sems kyi cho 'phrul 'khrul ba yang*// thams cad 'od gsal gzhi lam 'bras bu'i ngang*// gnyid mthug 'od gsal lam la brtson par mdzod// nyin snang 'khrul pa'i rtog pa 'gog pa'i thabs// sprul sgyur zhing khams sbyong ba la sogs pa// rmi lam dran pa'i snang brnyan sgom par mdzod// gang dag ngar 'dzin yan po'i gzu lum sogs| |phyogs lhung blo yi 'khrul pa rtsad gcod phyir// sgyu lus yang dag lam la nyams len mdzod// 'chi dus btsan thabs nyid du 'tshang rgya'i phyir/ /rlung sems yig 'bru'i sbyor ba drag po yis// 'pho ba'i dus thabs dag la 'bad par mdzod// tshe 'dir mchog grub nyid du ma gyur kyang*// skye 'chi srid pa'i bar do sbyong ba'i thabs/

/bar do'i lam la yang dag brtson par mdzod// bka' brgyud bstan pa'i rgyan gcig nā ro'i zhabs// des gsungs zab lam gdams pa'i gnad drug la// rtsol bcas rtsol med nyams su len pa sogs// lam bzang 'di nas// mda' dar thogs pa'i ḍā ki gnyis// ram 'degs tshul du g.yas g.yon 'khod// dus rtags lung bstan zhal gdams dang*// phan gnod rkyen dang tshe bsrung tshul// mgrin gcig bsdebs nas 'di skad gsung*/

/kye kye/ sngon tshe rdzogs ldan dus las deng sang yang*// nyi ma nub pa lta bu'i bskal ba 'dir// chos pas chos las log cing ya ga sgrog /sngags pa dam nyams gsang sngags zong du 'tshong*// dge slong thog yod pa lug yos rta sbrul lo// 'di rnams yid la zung la sgrub par mdzod// khyod srog bar chad byed pa'i skye bo zhig /ca wa'i ming can phag lo sbrul mig pa// 'di yi phyogs la nam yang gzab par ba'i don phyir sprul pa 'ga'// khams stod gtsang dang brag gsum phyogs su 'byung*// ya sa ra yi ming 'byung 'brug sbrul dang*// lug gi lo pa 'byung ba nges par mdzod| |de dag tshe 'phos 'gro ba re re bsdus pa// rin chen dpal gyi gshegs shul bstan pa'i srol| |bka' brgyud lam bzang myur lam thabs 'di yang*// rgyas shing spel ba'i 'bad rtsol g.yel med mdzod// ces gsungs gzhan yang dge ba dang*// mi dge'i lung bstan brjod dka' yang*// skye phreng du mar rjes 'dzin pa'i// shis brjod smon lam rgyas mdzad mthar// sku yi snang brnyan yi dam che// gshin rje'i gshed dang dbyer med ngos// ha ha'i gad rgyang cher sgrog cing*// ba spu'i khung bu re re nas// 'od zer kha dog 'bum 'bum 'phro// re re la yang zhi rgyas dbang*// drag po'i tshul gyis srid gsum 'di// khyom khyom mer mer gang bar mdzad| |bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro dang*// mchog gsum chos skyong sprin ltar g.yo// la lar rigs drug gnas tshul can// skyi g.ya'i bkod pa sna tshogs dang*// ya mtshan rtsed dgar spyod pa'ang*// 'ga' zhig tu ni kun bzang gi// mchod sprin rgya mtsho bshams pa ltar// dgos 'dod rin chen lha mi'i dpal// thams cad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin snang*// skabs 'gar nam mkha'i rang bzhin lags// mthar ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhin// snang ba'i klong nas 'di skad gsung*// thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul cher ston yang*// dper na chu zla sgyu ma zil pa bzhin// mnyam nyid stong pa'i ngang du ro gcig pa// bka' brgyud bstan pa'i snang bden bzung cher med kyang*// 'di ltar sgar du 'byor 'phral du// mgyogs par bris pa'i phyi mo zhig

/'di skor lhug pa'ang yod pa nges// zla ba bzhi pa'i yar tshes brgyad// gter sgrom gnas chen mjal du phyin// 'di thad mthong snang dran snang dang*// lha sku yig sna phyag mtshan bkod// legs nyes lung bstan dus rtags sogs// rang gi rkang lag 'dred rkyen gyis// rjes sogs zhib bsnyad mang yod kyang*// yi ger 'jigs phyir re zhig bzhag /bcu la tshogs khang yang steng du// tshogs kyi 'khor lo bgyis pa'i
